descriptionText:
Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform. The Backend Engineer - Connectivity will be responsible for building scalable distributed systems, working with various databases and technologies, and developing features for Verkada's connectivity products.
Responsibilities
Build scalable distributed systems capable of handling high traffic from 100s of thousands of devices deployed around the world
Work with high concurrency key-value storage systems (Redis, DynamoDB)
Work with Postgres relational databases
Work with logging and message passing technologies like Kafka and SQS
Deploy services via Terraform and Kubernetes
Develop large scale systems to interact with and configure products remotely
Define and improve low-latency, high-throughput, high-reliability microservice architectures
Design and develop features incorporating cutting edge computer vision
Design clean APIs and implement them using Python and/or Go
Skills
1+ years backend engineering experience in a production environment
BS/MS in Computer Science or similar technical field of study
Experience developing and launching products
Working knowledge of Python and/or Go
Comfortable working in an agile team software development environment
Familiarity with REST APIs, ability to read python server code a plus
Benefits
Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
Expanded mental health support
Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays
Firmwide extended holidays
Flexible PTO and personal sick time
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Healthy lunches provided daily
Commuter benefits
Professional development stipend
Wellness/fitness benefits
Company Overview
Verkada is a cyber security company that offers an AI integrated platform for cloud physical security. It was founded in 2016, and is headquartered in San Mateo, California, USA, with a workforce of 1001-5000 employees. Its website is https://www.verkada.com.
Company H1B Sponsorship
Verkada has a track record of offering H1B sponsorships, with 71 in 2026, 70 in 2025, 51 in 2024, 44 in 2023, 43 in 2022, 19 in 2021, 13 in 2020. Please note that this does not guarantee sponsorship for this specific role.
